title: Apple Seed Overnight Oats
yield_notes: Makes 4 portions. This is fictional starter content, not a cooking report.

ingredients.name: Apple
ingredients.detail: Wash and dice, discarding core and seeds.

steps.title: Set out the containers
steps.text: Use four clean containers with lids. Measure 160 g oats, 600 ml soy milk, 40 g pumpkin seeds and 2 g cinnamon.

steps.title: Mix the oats
steps.text: Divide 160 g oats, 600 ml soy milk and 2 g cinnamon evenly among the four containers. Stir until no dry oats remain.

steps.title: Add apple and seeds
steps.text: Wash and dice 200 g apple into small pieces. Divide the apple and 40 g pumpkin seeds among the containers. Stir, cover and refrigerate.

steps.title: Chill and serve
steps.text: Chill at least 6 hours until the oats soften. Stir before eating; add a little soy milk if too thick. Keep refrigerated and use within four days of preparation.

notes.storage: Refrigerate within two hours in shallow covered containers. Use within four days or freeze promptly.
notes.reheat: Heat stored savory portions until steaming throughout. Stir to eliminate cold spots.
notes.allergens: Check ingredient labels and adapt to your household needs before preparing.
